versions.content: The Rte_Trigger API shall return the follow- ing values: • RTE_E_OK if the trigger was successfully queued or if no queue is configured • RTE_E_LIMIT if the trigger was not queued because the maxi- mum queue size is already reached. in the case of signature with queuing support.

The Rte_IrTrigger API shall return the fol- lowing values: • RTE_E_OK if the trigger was successfully queued • RTE_E_LIMIT if the trigger was not queued because the maxi- mum queue size is already reached. if returnValueProvision of the related InternalTrigger- ingPoint (s) not set to noReturnValueProvided .

The Rte_IrTrigger API shall return the fol- lowing values: • RTE_E_OK if the trigger was successfully queued • RTE_E_LIMIT if the trigger was not queued because the maxi- mum queue size is already reached. if returnValueProvision of the related InternalTrigger- ingPoint (s) not set to noReturnValueProvided .

The Rte_IrTrigger API shall return the fol- lowing values: • RTE_E_OK if the trigger was successfully queued • RTE_E_LIMIT if the trigger was not queued because the maxi- mum queue size is already reached. if returnValueProvision of the related InternalTrigger- ingPoint (s) not set to noReturnValueProvided .
